g.text: ~incrementOrCreate(term : String, docId : int, tf : int) : void
~mergeBatch(terms : String[], hashes : int[], postings : Postings[], order : int[], from : int, to : int) : void
-probe(table : String[], term : String, hash : int) : int
-probe(table : String[], tableHashes : int[], term : String, hash : int) : int
shardCount is a power of two;
a term lives in shard fnv1a(term) & (shardCount - 1).
mergeFrom() buckets the local terms by shard
(counting sort), then visits shards in ascending
order and calls mergeBatch() on each: at most one
shard lock is held at a time.
Open addressing with linear probing; the slot uses
the hash bits above the shard bits (hashShift).
Grows by doubling when the load factor would exceed 0.7.
write lock, lookup() the read lock.
Per worker, never shared: no locks.
Same open addressing; add() folds repeated
terms of one document into a single posting.
